name: Shane Ward
headline: Certinia, Vice President of Global Professional Services
position: Vice President of Global Professional Services
about: Former military officer and accomplished professional services executive with more than 20 years of experience providing strategic leadership, driving customer success, increasing services profitability, and leveraging & enabling partners. Extensive experience selling and delivering complex business solutions across many industry verticals. A strong relationship builder capable of leading and growing complex organizations.

experiences.position: Vice President of Global Professional Services

experiences.description: Responsible for overseeing services portfolio of 230+ active projects across several verticals, including Advertising, Media, Publishing, Services, Software, and General Business.  Consistently delivered high customer satisfaction and projects on budget.  Led a team of 25 direct resources and 20+ extended team members from our Shared Resource Team and Global Delivery Center.  Responsible for delivery oversight and coordination of the Global Delivery Center, which includes locations in Philippines, India, and Brazil.

Led all aspects of services delivery for the Americas, which included Architecture & Engineering, Construction, Manufacturing, and Media & Entertainment industry segments.  Responsibilities included P&L management for consulting, customer satisfaction, and delivery execution oversight.  Responsible for $35M in revenue and achieved greater than 50% improvement in gross margins during the first year.  Led a team of 141 services professionals.

experiences.position: Vice President – Delivery Lead, Federal, Aerospace & Defense / Footwear & Apparel / Brazil
experiences.description: Led all aspects of services delivery for multiple business segments.  Responsibilities included P&L management for consulting, customer satisfaction, delivery quality, on-shore solution center management, cloud services, and training.  Managed revenue growth from $25M to $45M while achieving greater than 10% improvement in delivery margins.  Led a team of 130 services professionals.

Led the PLM & MCAD services business for the Heavy Industry sector.  Responsible for the business development and delivery of over $10 million in annual revenue.  Led a team of 25 services professionals.

experiences.position: Manager – Client Manager, Federal Aerospace & Defense
experiences.description: Managed PLM & MCAD services business within the Federal Aerospace and Defense sector.  Responsible for the selling and delivery of over $8 million in annual revenue and bookings.  Led a team of 15 services professionals.

experiences.position: Manager – Regional Consulting Manager, Southeast Region
experiences.description: Led the southeast region for PLM services.  Responsible for the selling and delivery of $4 million in annual revenue.  Led a team of 10 services professionals.

Delivered implementation services for PTC’s PLM solutions.  Services included business process re-engineering, software implementation, and training.  Served as technical lead on 2 of PTC’s earliest Windchill deployments.

Responsible for providing software and hardware configuration management support for 4 defense programs.   Supervised 5 configuration management engineers.  Lead the configuration management process improvement initiative across multiple Raytheon locations in the Dallas area.

Responsibilities included leadership of the Ground Support Platoon in B Company, 201st Forward Support Battalion in the 1st Infantry Division.  Led 54 soldiers who provided direct support automotive maintenance to the 1st ID combat battalions.  Also served as the 201st Battalion Personnel Officer responsible for all personnel actions for a 600 plus person battalion, including promotions, pay, disciplinary actions, performance reviews, quarterly reviews, and mail.  Led a staff of 10 soldiers.
